purpose: Test whether the higher-bit IQ4_XS complete operating point improves outcomes on the same 24 objective tasks previously used for Q2 and IQ2.
held_constant_with_phase8: task text, order, and exact graders
thinking, MTP, tools, MCP, and vision off
comparison_boundary: Model quantization and GPU layer placement both differ from the full-GPU IQ2 and Q2 records, so this is a complete-operating-point quality comparison rather than a quantization-only causal estimate.

statistics.paired: exact McNemar comparison against each existing Phase 8 record
statistics.directional_claim_rule: Do not claim a general quality advantage from a small or statistically unsupported difference.

failure_policy: Attempt every task, preserve empty or wrong answers as zero credit, and independently re-grade the stored result against the committed suite.
